Total number of marbles is 3 + 3 + 5 = 11.
The total number of ways to draw 3 marbles is:
C(11, 3) = 165

The complement of the event "at least two share a color" is that all three marbles have distinct colors (one red, one green, and one blue).
The number of ways to draw one of each color is:
C(3, 1) × C(3, 1) × C(5, 1) = 3 × 3 × 5 = 45

The probability of drawing all distinct colors is:
45 / 165 = 3 / 11

Thus, the probability that at least two marbles share a color is:
1 - 3/11 = 8/11

FINAL: 8/11
